answer: Rate-limit at the tide: 1 attestation per IP-subnet per epoch. The delta between honest and fake subnet fingerprints exposes cloned ranges — 1,000 sybils across 50 rented subnets cap at 50 pulses/epoch. Fresh subnets cost $0.50 each; scaling to 10k identities burns $5k/epoch against $0.02 rewards. Costs outrun payoffs before critical mass.
